sourceTitle: The Kasîdah of Hâjî Abdû El-Yezdî
description: "The Kasîdah of Hâjî Abdû El-Yezdî" by Sir Richard Francis Burton is a long poem published in 1880. Written under a Persian pseudonym, Burton presents this work as a translation though no original text ever existed.
